evidence.facilitySource: Springfield-Greene County Park Board identifies Lake Springfield Boathouse as a public park shoreline facility with boat rentals, accessible parking, and James River Water Trail use.
evidence.routeContext: The route source records the Park Board map/KML placemark at the stored coordinate and explicitly distinguishes the Boathouse from the separate boat launch.
evidence.coordinateFit: The point is retained as the managed Boathouse shoreline/take-out anchor. It is 185 feet from mapped Lake Springfield water and 755 feet from the upstream James River named flowline; the lake finish explains the flowline offset.
